help.title: Help
help.quick.import.title: Import Sounds
help.quick.import.desc: Click "+ Add Sounds" at the top and choose audio files. MP3 / WAV / OGG / FLAC / WMA / AAC / AIFF / OPUS and more are supported without extra codecs.
help.quick.play.title: Play Sounds
help.quick.play.desc: Click a sound card to play immediately. If it is already playing, it restarts from the beginning. Multiple sounds can overlap.
help.quick.hotkey.title: Set Hotkeys
help.quick.hotkey.desc: Right-click a card ? Edit Sound ? Hotkey, then click Record and press your target key combination such as Ctrl+1.
help.quick.clip.title: Clip Sounds
help.quick.clip.desc: Right-click a card ? Clip Sound, then drag the blue / orange handles on the waveform to play only the selected segment.
help.features.tags.title: Tag Categories
help.features.tags.desc: Click "+ New Tag" to create categories. Use right-click ? Add to Tag to classify sounds. Tags support drag sorting, and deleting a tag does not delete sounds.
help.features.bgm.title: Background Music
help.features.bgm.desc: Switch to the Background Music page to import BGM. Double-click an item to start playback. The bottom bar can pause, adjust volume, and toggle loop.
help.features.floating.title: Floating Window
help.features.floating.desc: A tiny always-on-top control panel for checking hotkey status while your streaming software or game stays in the foreground. Toggle it in Settings ? Floating Window.
help.features.backup.title: Backup & Restore
help.features.backup.desc: The Backup & Restore page exports all sounds, BGMs, and settings to a .zip file. Import supports both overwrite and merge modes.
help.hotkeys.global.title: Global Mode
help.hotkeys.global.desc: Hotkeys work in any window, including streaming software or games in the foreground. Admin rights are required; otherwise the app falls back to local mode.
help.hotkeys.local.title: Local Mode
help.hotkeys.local.desc: Hotkeys work only when this app window is focused. It is suitable when background triggering is not needed and requires no special permissions.
help.hotkeys.function.title: Function Hotkeys
help.hotkeys.function.desc: In Settings ? Function Hotkeys you can customize stop all sounds, BGM play/pause, BGM volume up/down, toggle hotkey mode, minimize window, show floating window, and more.
help.faq.mp3.title: MP3 Import Failed
help.faq.mp3.desc: The app bundles ffmpeg, so MP3 import should work directly. If it still fails, check whether the file is corrupted or try converting it to WAV first.
help.faq.hotkey.title: Hotkeys Not Responding (Global Mode)
help.faq.hotkey.desc: Global hotkeys require administrator privileges. Right-click Live Soundboard.exe and choose Run as administrator.
help.faq.device.title: Switch Output Device
help.faq.device.desc: Choose the target device in Settings ? Output Device or from the bottom control bar. Changes take effect immediately without restart.
help.faq.data.title: Where Data Is Stored
help.faq.data.desc: All sound files and configuration are stored in the data/ folder next to Live Soundboard.exe. Include that folder when making a manual backup.
help.credits_text: This software was crafted with dedication by Mr. Liu Muye. From concept to development, it represents a labor of love and passion, committed to delivering the finest sound effects management experience for live streamers.
